summary: Modal for Startups grants a one-time award of free GPU/platform credits ('thousands' per the program page, not itemized) plus engineering/GTM support and a founder community. Eligibility: new Modal customers; Seed–Series A tier requires VC funding from Modal's partner network or >$1M raised from any fund; a Scaling/Series B+ tier exists for >$30M raised / post-Series B with a partner-network VC. Credits are a one-time grant per tier, last one year, cannot be reinstated after expiry, and cannot pay plan fees or endpoint charges. Credit status and expiration are shown on the billing page. A payment method is required so apps can continue after credits run out; monitor usage and stop unwanted billable apps to avoid ongoing costs. Create a Modal workspace before applying; the form requires its name, an email tied to it, and proof of funding.
claim_steps: Create a Modal account and organization workspace first (new Modal customers only).
Apply at modal.com/startups with the workspace name, an email tied to that workspace, and proof of funding.
Seed–Series A: VC funding from Modal's partner network, or >$1M raised from any fund.
On acceptance, the one-time credit grant lands on your account; add a payment method as required so apps can continue after credits run out.
Credits last one year and cannot be reinstated after expiry. Check credit status and expiration on the billing page.
Credits cannot pay plan fees or endpoint charges. Monitor usage and stop unwanted billable apps before credits run out to avoid ongoing costs.
